en.headline: Tram service suspended between North Point and Happy Valley after power fault
en.dek: Westbound services from North Point Terminus to Tin Lok Lane were halted from about 6pm; eastbound services later resumed while engineers worked on the fault.
body: Hong Kong Tramways suspended westbound services between North Point Terminus and Tin Lok Lane (Happy Valley circuit) after a power fault on Monday evening, the Transport Department said.
The disruption began around 6pm, with more than a dozen trams queued in the Causeway Bay area. Passengers were advised to alight and switch to other transport.

By 8pm the department reported that westbound services on the affected section remained suspended, while eastbound services from Percival Street to North Point Terminus had resumed. Engineering staff were on site carrying out repairs.
The Shek Tong Tsui Terminus was temporarily out of use for the affected services.

zh.headline: 北角至天樂里西行電車因電力故障暫停服務
zh.dek: 傍晚約6時起北角總站至天樂里（跑馬地圈）西行線電車暫停，東行線其後恢復，工程人員搶修。
body: 運輸署表示，香港電車周一傍晚因電力故障，暫停北角總站至天樂里（跑馬地圈）之間的西行線服務。
故障約於晚上6時開始，銅鑼灣一帶有十多部電車大排長龍，乘客需下車轉乘其他交通工具。
至晚上8時，署方網頁顯示西行線受影響路段服務仍暫停，而波斯富街至北角總站的東行線已恢復。電車公司工程人員正進行搶修。
石塘嘴總站臨時停用相關服務。
